buildings.name: Mining Complex
buildings.effect: Extracts the deposit under it into storage (ore goes to a refinery).
buildings.description: A drilling derrick that sits on a surveyed deposit and digs it into storage until it runs dry. Ore still needs a refinery; deuterium, dilithium and strategic deposits come out ready to use. Salvage a used-up mine to free the tile, and a Deep-Core Mine can reopen the deposit later.
